architecture_summary: VoltPoint is a Symfony 7 MVC web application for locating and managing electric vehicle charging stations. Requests enter through public/index.php, which boots src/Kernel.php (a MicroKernelTrait-based kernel); routing is attribute-based and auto-discovered from src/Controller (config/routes.yaml). Controllers under src/Controller (public/user-facing) and src/Controller/Admin (ROLE_ADMIN-gated) use constructor-injected Doctrine repositories (src/Repository) to load Entities (src/Entity: User, Station, Evse, Connector, RechargeSession) and render Twig templates from templates/. Symfony Forms (src/Form) and small Data DTOs (src/Data, e.g. UserFilter) back filterable list views (stations, sessions, users). Authentication is form-login based via src/Security/UserAuthenticator with role-based access control defined in config/packages/security.yaml (ROLE_USER for /stations, /profile, /session; ROLE_ADMIN for /admin). Persistence is MariaDB via Doctrine ORM/DBAL with migrations in migrations/, and a couple of console commands (src/Command) exist for admin/connector bootstrap. The app is containerized with Docker Compose (PHP-FPM/Nginx/MariaDB, see docker/ and docker-compose.yml).
code_conventions: All PHP files start with `declare(strict_types=1);` and use PSR-4 autoloading under the App\ namespace (src/). Controllers extend AbstractController, use PHP 8 attribute routing (#[Route(...)]) with named routes in snake_case (e.g. view_stations, info_station), and receive dependencies via constructor property promotion with `private readonly` typed properties. Admin-only controllers live under src/Controller/Admin and are additionally prefixed with #[Route('/admin')]. Doctrine entities use attribute mapping (#[ORM\Entity], #[ORM\Column], etc.), UUID primary keys via CustomIdGenerator, and standard getter/setter methods; some entity fields mix English and French naming (e.g. `prix`, `disponibility`). Repositories extend Doctrine's ServiceEntityRepository and add custom finder methods (e.g. findByFilter, findOneStation, getAllStation). Twig templates are organized by feature folder (admin/, station/, evse/, user/, recharge_session/, registration/, security/) mirroring controller groupings, generally extending a shared template.html.twig/base.html.twig layout. Filtering UI follows a Data-object + FormType pattern (e.g. UserFilter + FilterForm).
